visible_text: マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く
AI が見ている資料 ー まだありません

answers.q1: A meeting recording just started 2 seconds ago; the app is actively listening to the microphone and system audio and waiting for someone to speak so it can transcribe and summarize.
answers.q2: The recording status itself — the red '録音中 00:02' indicator and the 'マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています' line — since that's the only proof the app is actually capturing the meeting right now.
answers.q3: Pause or stop the recording from the floating toolbar, expand it, switch between 文字起こし/翻訳/字幕 tabs, type a question in 'この会議について聞く', or wait for 決まったこと/やること/リアルタイム要約/決定事項/アクション to populate once speech is detected.
answers.q4: Only weakly — the '聞いています…' text and timer suggest it's running, but every content panel (transcript, decisions, to-dos, referenced materials) is still empty placeholder text, so there is no concrete evidence yet that transcription or analysis is actually working.
answers.q5: The floating toolbar's '…' (more) and comment-bubble icons feel premature this early with nothing to act on yet; having three empty placeholder panels (transcript box, decided/to-do list, four action buttons) all visible at once before any content exists feels like clutter.
answers.q6: The black floating toolbar at the top center with the red recording dot and stop button, because it's the highest-contrast element on the page.

weaknesses.what: Every content area (transcript, 決まったこと, やること, referenced materials) shows only placeholder 'waiting' text with no live signal that audio is truly being captured or understood.
weaknesses.fix: Add a small live audio-level meter or animated waveform next to 'マイク と 画面の音 を聞いています' so the user gets continuous visual proof of capture before any transcript appears.

weaknesses.what: The floating toolbar icons (comment bubble, expand, '…', stop) have no text labels, so their function is ambiguous on first viewing.
weaknesses.fix: Add hover tooltips or brief micro-labels under each icon in the floating toolbar.

weaknesses.what: The entire screen is functional but sterile — nothing signals life or progress beyond static placeholder sentences.
weaknesses.fix: Give the 'listening' state a subtle pulsing or breathing animation so the waiting period feels active rather than frozen.
